592: '    "def solve_burgers_spectral(u0, nu, T, n_steps=5000):\\n",'
593: '    "    \\"\\"\\"\\n",'
594: '    "    使用稳定的谱方法求解一维 Burgers 方程（伪谱法 + 去别名）\\n",'
595: '    "    \\n",'
596: '    "    参数:\\n",'
597: '    "        u0: 初始条件（numpy 数组）\\n",'
598: '    "        nu: 粘度系数\\n",'
599: '    "        T: 最终时间\\n",'
600: '    "        n_steps: 时间步数\\n",'
601: '    "        \\n",'
602: '    "    返回:\\n",'
603: '    "        时刻 T 的解\\n",'
604: '    "    \\"\\"\\"\\n",'
605: '    "    N = len(u0)\\n",'
606: '    "    x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, N, endpoint=False)\\n",'
607: '    "    k = np.fft.fftfreq(N, 1.0 / N)\\n",'
608: '    "    dt = T / n_steps\\n",'
609: '    "    u = u0.copy()\\n",'
610: '    "\\n",'
611: '    "    # 2/3 去别名掩码\\n",'
612: '    "    dealias = np.abs(k) > (2.0 / 3.0) * (N / 2)\\n",'
613: '    "\\n",'
614: '    "    # 显式格式的时间步进，并在非线性项上做去别名\\n",'
615: '    "    for _ in range(n_steps):\\n",'
616: '    "        u_hat = np.fft.fft(u)\\n",'
617: '    "        u_x_hat = 1j * k * u_hat\\n",'
618: '    "        u_x = np.fft.ifft(u_x_hat).real\\n",'
619: '    "\\n",'
620: '    "        nonlinear = -u * u_x\\n",'
